title: Sweet Jeebus, macOS 27 Golden Gate Removes the Dumb Icons from Menu Items
summary: John Gruber of Daring Fireball comments on Apple's rumored macOS 27 'Golden Gate' update, specifically praising the removal of unnecessary icons from menu bar items that he considers visual clutter.
problem_solved: Addresses the cluttered and inconsistent visual design of macOS menu bar items.
why_valuable: Demonstrates Apple's renewed focus on thoughtful UI design by eliminating unnecessary visual elements that served no functional purpose.
